result.markdown:
# Traffic Drop in the South Due to Planned Fiber Maintenance

- **Classification:** planned_maintenance
- **Root cause:** planned_maintenance at `LNK-SUD-01-A`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct evidence links the maintenance window on the shared fiber link to the exact timing of site downtime.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-09 01:15 to 2026-09-09 08:07
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-09 02:53
- **Affected:** S-SUD-003, S-SUD-006

## Summary

Planned fiber splice work on link LNK-SUD-01-A caused downstream sites S-SUD-003 and S-SUD-006 to go offline.

Traffic, active users, and availability dropped to zero on two sites in the South for approximately seven hours.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-09 01:15: Traffic, active users, and availability drop started on sites S-SUD-003 and S-SUD-006. [T1, ALR-0007]
- 2026-09-09 01:29: Critical SITE_DOWN alarms raised on S-SUD-006 and S-SUD-003. [T2, ALM-000156, ALM-000157]
- 2026-09-09 02:53: Planned maintenance MW-0007 started on fiber link LNK-SUD-01-A. [T4, MW-0007]
- 2026-09-09 08:00: Planned maintenance MW-0007 completed. [T4, MW-0007]
- 2026-09-09 08:04: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SUD-006. [T2, ALM-000156]
- 2026-09-09 08:07: SITE_DOWN alarm cleared on S-SUD-003 and impact ended. [T2, ALM-000157, ALR-0007]

## Evidence

- Sites S-SUD-003 and S-SUD-006 experienced availability, active users, and traffic drops from 2026-09-09 01:15 to 08:15. [T1, ALR-0007]
- Both affected sites depend on the shared fiber link LNK-SUD-01-A. [T5, T6]
- MW-0007 for planned fiber splice work on LNK-SUD-01-A occurred between 2026-09-09 02:53 and 08:00 with expected downstream site offline impact. [T4, MW-0007]
- No configuration changes were made on S-SUD-003, S-SUD-006, or their parent nodes during the incident window. [T3]
- No external events were reported in region SUD between 2026-09-08 18:00 and 2026-09-09 06:00. [T7]

## Hypotheses

1. **planned_maintenance** at LNK-SUD-01-A: confirmed. Planned maintenance MW-0007 on the shared fiber link directly matches the downstream site outages and traffic drop. [T4, MW-0007]
2. **bad_change**: rejected. No changes were recorded on the affected sites or their ancestor nodes during the incident window. [T3]

## Ruled out

- T3: No configuration changes were found on the sites or parent nodes during the incident timeframe.
- T7: External events check returned no recorded events in the region during the incident window.

## Recommended actions

- Verify post-maintenance traffic restoration on S-SUD-003 and S-SUD-006.
- Ensure alignment between planned maintenance schedules and actual site alarm timestamps.

confounders.why: A window on LNK-SUD-01-A that opens 85 min after the outage began; it covers only the repair, not the start of the outage.

truth.notes: trap=near_miss_maintenance; Fibre cut on LNK-SUD-01-A; all 2 downstream sites lost service until repair. The maintenance window opened 85 min after the cut, so the first 85 min of the outage are outside it and only the repair period is inside. Trap: a splice window on the right link covers the end of the outage (LNK-SUD-01-A), but the outage started well before it opened. Settled by: (1) LINK_LOS and SITE_DOWN were raised, and the sites were down, 85 min before the window starts, which fails the time test of the maintenance runbook; (2) the window closes when service returns, so it describes the repair, not the cause.
